**Install:** unpack the zip anywhere and run `loom.exe`. Needs a GPU with Vulkan. Windows only for now.

**Textures:** the game comes with its own. If Minecraft is installed through the official launcher or Prism, Loom builds a resource pack from your copy on the first start (Settings > Resource Packs to turn it off). Nothing from Mojang is included or downloaded.

**Multiplayer:** pause menu > Multiplayer > Open to Friends gives a ticket; your friend pastes it into Multiplayer > Join.

**Mods:** put a mod's `.zip` into `run/mods/`. Mods are native libraries and have to be built for the same engine version, see the [modding cheat sheet](https://github.com/VortexSo4/Loom/blob/master/docs/modding.md).

The mod interface and the save format can still change between versions.
